confirm.deleteCollectionText: Bookmarks of «{{name}}» stay in the library without a collection.

connect.title: Connect browser
connect.lead: From the browser to the library
connect.ready: The app is ready to receive links
connect.install: Install the extension from the extension/chrome folder with «Load unpacked» in Chrome, then open its settings.
connect.desktopOnly: The connection key is available in the Netami Pin desktop app.
connect.queue: While the app is closed, the extension keeps links in a local queue and delivers them on the next start.
connect.bookmarkletHow: Drag the button to the bookmarks bar or copy the code into the address of a new bookmark.
connect.bookmarkletLimits: «Sent» means the request was sent; the bookmarklet does not check the result. Browser restrictions may block access to the local server.
connect.bookmarkletFailed: Start Netami Pin and try again

notice.copyFailed: Copying is unavailable. Select the text by hand.

empty.local: The library is stored only on this computer.
empty.noResultsHint: Try another query or clear the filters.
empty.noFavoritesHint: Mark a bookmark with the star — it will appear here.
empty.emptyCollectionHint: Add a link here or move bookmarks from the library.

library.damaged: The library is damaged: the integrity check found errors in the file. To avoid further damage, changes are no longer saved and links from the browser wait in the extension. Quit Netami Pin and replace the file with the latest backup.
library.movedAside: The library of an earlier test build does not fit the new schema. It was kept as {{path}} and a new library was created.

gate.reportFailed: Could not copy. Select the report text manually.

DB_LOCKED.title: The library is in use by another program
DB_LOCKED.body: Another program has the library file open. Netami Pin has not written anything to it — your data is as it was. Close that program and click Try again.

DB_NEWER_SCHEMA.title: A newer version of Netami Pin has updated this library
DB_NEWER_SCHEMA.body: The library uses schema {{schema}}; this version supports up to {{supported}}. Install the latest version from pin.netami.app. The library has not been changed.

DB_FOREIGN.title: This is not a Netami Pin library
DB_FOREIGN.body: The file was created by another program. Netami Pin does not open or change it. Move the file out of the data folder and a new library will be created on the next start.

DB_NOT_DATABASE.title: The library file cannot be read
DB_NOT_DATABASE.body: The file is damaged or is not a database. Netami Pin does not change it. Replace it with the latest copy from the backups folder and click Try again.

DB_CORRUPT.title: The library is damaged
DB_CORRUPT.body: The integrity check found errors in the library file. To avoid further damage, Netami Pin does not update or change it. Replace the file with the latest copy from the backups folder and click Try again.

BACKUP_FAILED.title: Could not back up the library before updating it
BACKUP_FAILED.body: {{detail}}. Your data has not been changed.

MIGRATION_FAILED.title: Could not update the library
MIGRATION_FAILED.body: Your data has not been changed.{{backupNote}} The app does not use the library until the error is fixed: send the report to support.

DB_OPEN_FAILED.title: Could not open the library
DB_OPEN_FAILED.body: {{detail}}. Your data has not been changed.

errors.disk_full: The disk is full — the changes were not saved.
errors.read_only: The library is damaged and open read-only — changes are not saved.
errors.database_busy: Another program is using the library. Try again in a few seconds.
